name: dev-playbook
description: Your team's coding standards, in context. Serves guardrails, definition of done, per-language rules and task workflows over MCP - and scaffolds them for a repo that has none.

server_url.title: Shared server URL
server_url.description: Team mode: the base URL of a shared dev-playbook server, e.g. http://localhost:3001. Leave empty to run a local server on stdio, which needs no infrastructure.

token.title: Bearer token
token.description: Bearer token for the shared server, from POST /auth/login. Only needed when server_url is set and that server has auth enabled.

server_path.title: Server directory
server_path.description: Path to the repo's mcp/ directory. Only needed if the plugin cannot find it next to itself - it normally resolves automatically from the marketplace clone.

enforce_standards.title: Enforce standards
enforce_standards.description: Block the first Write/Edit of a session when the project's standards are missing, instead of only warning. Off by default: installing a plugin should not stop anyone's work by surprise.
